public.5: A B O U T T H E A U T H O R Dr. Rakesh Kumar Jain Vice Chancellor Ajeenkya D Y Patil University, Pune, since August 2024 Qualifications Ph.D. (Transportation Engineering) M.E. (Town Planning) B.E. (Civil Engineering) Dr. Rakesh Kumar Jain is an academic and researcher with more than 38 years of experience in higher education and institutional leadership. As Vice Chancellor of Ajeenkya D Y Patil University, he has led a period of institutional growth and national recognition, including the university's NAAC 'A' grade in its first cycle, its first NIRF appearance in Engineering and the QS I-GAUGE Diamond rating. His research covers transportation engineering, geotechnical engineering and town planning. He has written more than seven books, published more than 150 research papers, guided 12 Ph.D. scholars and attracted research funding of nearly ₹1 crore. A widely respected voice on quality assurance, he has served as a Programme Evaluator for NBA and NAAC and as Chairman or Member of the Expert Committee at NBA, New Delhi, on outcome-based education. He has been recognised as an "Ambassador" for guiding institutions towards NAAC accreditation and as a Margdarshak by AICTE for mentoring institutions seeking NBA accreditation. He has served as Chairman of the Board of Studies and Member of the Academic Council, and on university and state-level urban development committees. He has received many awards and honours from reputed organisations and government agencies at state and national level. His vision for ADYPU is to be a "digitally enabled institution of excellence, innovation and inclusivity", preparing learners for the digital age and contributing to a more equitable and sustainable society. 38+ years in higher education 150+ research papers 7+ books authored 12 Ph.D. scholars guided University Excellence 360° & Accreditation, Ranking & Recognition | Front Matter iv CONTENTS A-Z
public.6: P R E F A C E From Compliance to Eminence Every university wants to be excellent. Few manage to make excellence systematic: designed into governance, measured in every process, and visible to regulators, rankings, employers and students. This book is written to close that gap. Section 1, University Excellence 360°, sets out an integrated framework with three pillars: Compliance & Governance, Process & Quality Excellence and Institutional & Global Excellence. It goes on to policies, SOPs, a ten-year roadmap, eight challenge playbooks and nine annexures that cover every major function of a university, from vision and mission to examinations, research, innovation, student progression and campus facilities. Section 2, Accreditation, Ranking & Recognition, is a practical guide to the national and global systems that judge universities: NAAC, NBA, NIRF, QS, THE, ratings, international accreditation, awards and reputation. It also explains 14 international professional bodies whose accreditation adds global value to our programmes. Section 3, the Strategic Planner 2027–2029, turns the framework and the knowledge into action for Ajeenkya D Y Patil University. It covers ten strategic goals, eight pillars, year-wise targets, a KPI dashboard, a master roadmap, month-by-month planners, governance, resources and risks. ADYPU has achieved a great deal in a short time. The next three years must convert that quality into measurable, ranked and globally visible distinction. I invite every member of our community to treat this book as a working companion: read it, use it, challenge it and improve it. Compliance is our foundation. Quality is our culture. Excellence is our identity. Recognition is the outcome. Dr. Rakesh Kumar Jain Vice Chancellor, Ajeenkya D Y Patil University Pune, January 2027 University Excellence 360° & Accreditation, Ranking & Recognition | Front Matter v CONTENTS A-Z
